privileged_info_for_vlm: The conditions file MUST be at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/prp_conditions.csv and MUST contain these 5 columns: tone_freq, letter, soa, corr_resp_tone, corr_resp_letter. There must be at least 10 rows. The experiment file MUST be at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/prp_task.psyexp. In the trial routine, the auditory stimulus starts at 0.5s, the visual stimulus starts at 0.5 + soa, and the keyboard components must NOT terminate the routine early (Force end of Routine = False) to allow for dual responses over the 3.0s window.
